meta.title: Diagonal Tension: Skin, Stringers and Doubler
meta.question: At the same applied shear load, what changes when a doubler is added to an aluminium skin-and-stringer panel?
assumptions: Linear elastic, small displacement, pre-buckling membrane model: it gives the diagonal principal tension and how stress redistributes, not a post-buckling tension field.
Skin: four-node plane-stress quadrilaterals, 2 x 2 Gauss integration, isotropic E and Poisson ratio.
Stringers: two-node axial bars (EA/L) on skin nodes along x, running the full panel length; no bending, crippling or eccentricity.
Doubler: the same material as the skin, perfectly attached, modelled as a local increase in membrane thickness; no fastener slip or one-sided bending.
Load: a uniform shear flow q on all four edges, integrated consistently into nodal forces; the load is self-equilibrated and identical for both variants.
Restraints: minimal in-plane supports that remove rigid-body motion only: ux = uy = 0 at (0, 0) and uy = 0 at (L, 0).

Comparisons use unsmoothed Gauss-point stresses. Zones within the exclusion distance of the panel edges and of each doubler corner are excluded: point and corner stresses there are singular or load-introduction effects, not converged strength.
Material values are demonstration inputs, not alloy allowables; supply allowables yourself.

convergence.note: Three uniform element sizes on the demonstration model, variant B. Between the two finest meshes, fixed-probe displacements and compliance change by at most displacementTol (relative) and the comparison-region maxima of principal tension by at most stressTol. Displacement and compliance changes must shrink under refinement; region maxima, sampled at Gauss points, may oscillate within stressTol.

regions.excluded: Within the exclusion distance of a panel edge or of a doubler corner.
regions.band: Skin outside the doubler, within the band width of its outline (doubler edges).

probes.P3: Inside the patch at (x0 + Lx/2, y0 + Ly/4): stress at the nearest Gauss point.
probes.P4: Skin beside the patch at (x0 + Lx + band/2, y0 + Ly/4), or, where that is outside the panel, at (x0 - band/2, y0 + Ly/4), (x0 + Lx/2, y0 + Ly + band/2) or (x0 + Lx/2, y0 - band/2): stress at the nearest Gauss point. Left out when the doubler leaves no skin beside it.

meta.example: Demonstration values: 600 x 400 x 1 mm skin; stringers at y = 100, 200 and 300 mm, 50 mm² each; a central 200 x 200 x 1 mm doubler; E = 70,000 MPa, nu = 0.33, density 2,700 kg/m³; q = 50 N/mm; element size 20 mm.
